profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
I would love to work on anything challenging with a group of passionate computer scientists who value finding the best solutions to problems long before writing code.

Specialties: Java, PHP, Javascript, Python, C++, Qt, QML

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Building AI tooling and ML Platforms
positions.insights: Skills: vllm · Model Inference · ML Tooling

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: I lead the Integrations Team and I'm primarily responsible for the architecture and implementation of the on-prem portion of our LLM Secure product, which is a real time Gen AI, data, and model monitoring solution. The Integrations Team is responsible for generating software bridges to other ecosystems and tools for our open source libraries whylogs and langkit, like Kafka, BigQuery, and Snowflake.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped get our initial model and data monitoring application released and then moved on to found the Integrations Team, which is responsible for generating a breadth of software solutions to make integration with our open source libraries possible for customers.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead for the architecture of Amazon Halo's Android/iOS app. The application will be used by millions of Amazon customers. It also acts as a platform to a dozen internal teams that use our tools to develop the experiences in the app. I played a large role in our technology and language choices, platform api design, build system development, and release strategy from day 0.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: I worked in Consumer Engagement. My team was responsible for Amazon's chat platform that premiered in the Q&A section of Amazon's detail pages where customers could connect with the customers who answered their questions to have follow up conversations. I launched the web version using React, ES6, Webpack and a suite of other modern (at the time) front end development tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the Display Advertising Platform, creating Amazon's self-service Demand Side Platform (DSP). I was heavily involved in the Javascript, user interface and API design of the site, as well as integrating it with dozens of Amazon specific platforms and services.

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description: Intellergy is a quickly expanding company. I worked with other UMaine students and a professor to make sure they met their product and demo deadlines.

positions.title: Student Technical Support
positions.description: My colleagues and I communicate with the Technical Coordinators at Schools and Libraries throughout Maine offering a broad range of supports, whether it be blocking Facebook for certain users in their network range, setting up their own mail servers, configuring Apache, or just getting their own network up and running after an equipment change.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked closely with a graduate student to create a web application to aid scientists at our Farmington campus in plotting and managing large amounts of lake temperature readings.

projects.title: Coexist
projects.description: Coexist is a framework that allows Android and web clients to perform CRUD operations on a shared database by writing a single JSON configuration file.

projects.title: Linkedup
projects.description: Mobile LinkedIn application for Maemo and Meego
